description: Registry + classification for every skill the template knows about. 'ported' skills physically exist under agent-src/skills/<scope>/<group>/<name>/ and are fanned out by sync.ps1. 'catalogued' skills are classified here so a later sync can pull them from their source repo; they have no local folder yet. 'drop' entries are recorded so the decision is not silently re-litigated.

roundTripToShared.comment: Only core skills round-trip to the shared product tier (shared/dv). Project skills never sync upstream.

skills.name: aidevme-shared-scripts
skills.note: Library skill dot-sourced by Dataverse/ADO skills (Invoke-DataverseApi + auth + ProjectConfig). Ported Forge body neutralised; governance modules (Wiki-Tiers, Resolve-GovernanceContext) deferred to review-later.

skills.name: aidevme-skills-sync
skills.note: Parity backstop, rewritten for the inverted source-is-committed model; double-nesting bug fixed.

skills.name: aidevme-skill-recorder
skills.note: Ports the aidevme/skill-recorder method (intent + ordered steps, generalise, UI-to-API mapping, review gate, redaction) into a skill. Name kept without hso- prefix by request.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.note: Anthropic upstream base scaffolder. Reclassified meta->delivery to match its on-disk placement (delivery batch). aidevme-skill-creator wraps it and remains in meta.

skills.name: worklog
skills.note: Per-session gitignored work log; neutralised ticket-key regex.

skills.name: aidevme-github

skills.name: aidevme-vitepress
